about: P10-P1 code.run@1: av-events (producer) -> agentvillage-data ingest (consumer). Observe-only, default OFF.
One event per outer execute_code call, built in post_tool_call after tool.call, from the call's own args, result, status and error_type.
Closed: every key always present, in this order; no code text, output text, path, host, env name or value; no id beyond tool.call's envelope ids.
evidence_class agent_report (the plugin runs as the hermes uid, the same uid as the program it describes); actor agent; event_id a fresh uuid v7.

consent_scope says how data should keep it: all = ops security monitoring for every tenant (to be on the ops allowlist, kept without research consent only when consent_scope is all, as cron.run is kept only for installer jobs); research_consented = research consent only, like tool.call.
Held to plugins/av-events/_code_run.py by tests/test_code_run.py; agentvillage-data mirrors it when it registers the type.
patterns: every regex below is applied with fullmatch (Python re.fullmatch, TypeScript ^...$ without the m flag): a trailing newline never passes

scope_switch.unknown_log: one WARNING per process naming the variable, never the value

code_hmac.null_when: metadata capture, no hash key, or no string code

code_bytes.null_when: metadata capture or no string code

scan_truncated.true_when: the tags or the refusal count read only the first 262144 characters of the program or of a result text; code_hmac and code_bytes always cover the whole program
